answer: Challenge-bound work receipts: each identity must submit a solution whose seed is derived from the prior receipt, so answers cannot be copied across identities. A wharf terminal validates the chain and rejects any receipt reused from another agent. The yarrow field in each submission encodes a per-epoch salt tied to the identity's key, making replay detectable at submission time. An attacker pays one fresh computation and a crystal signature per identity, so mass registration costs linear compute plus key storage, not a single reusable proof.
